title: Deposit Percentage for Larger Window Projects
content:
# Deposit Percentage for Larger Window Projects

Window Replacement Contracts. The deposit percentage used for a contract paid by cash, check or card steps down with the measured contract value: at least $25000.00 (the large-project value) takes the series deposit percentage less the large-project step of 0.1 (10 percentage points); at least $15000.00 (the mid-project value) but less than $25000.00 takes the series deposit percentage less the mid-project step of 0.05 (5 percentage points); a lower value takes the series deposit percentage.

The measured contract value is the signed contract price plus the change-order lines and the fees on the contract, less the price credits.

| Measured contract value | Deposit percentage used |
|---|---|
| $25000.00 or more | Series deposit percentage less 0.1 |
| $15000.00 to $24999.99 | Series deposit percentage less 0.05 |
| Below $15000.00 | Series deposit percentage |

## Hypothetical cases (series deposit percentage taken as a hypothetical 45%)

- Measured value $14,999.99: 45%.
- Measured value $15,000: 40%.
- Measured value $25,000: 35%.
